subject: MSBA Core Program Eligibility Phase
overview: The School Committee celebrated three outgoing members, accepted an educational grant donation, and discussed Medford High School's acceptance into the Massachusetts School Building Authority core program eligibility phase. The committee also requested a February progress report on recommendations from the high school assessment.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payroll, and minutes from December 4, 2023.

items.title: Recognition of Outgoing School Committee Members
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent and committee members honored outgoing members Kathy Kreatz, Mia Mustone, and Sharon Hays for their service to the district.

items.title: Medford Educational Foundation Donation
items.summary: The committee approved the acceptance of a $13,058.86 donation from the Medford Educational Foundation to fund teacher grant requests.

items.title: Medford High School and MVTHS Updates
items.summary: Principals Marta Cabral and Chad Fallon presented quarterly updates regarding academics, community events, student life, and vocational-technical construction and cooperative education programs.

items.title: MSBA Core Program Eligibility Phase Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced that Medford High School was invited into phase one of the Massachusetts School Building Authority core program, initiating a 270-day eligibility period to establish scope and forming a school building committee.

items.title: High School Assessment Recommendations Report Request
items.summary: The committee approved a requested report directing the administration to present a progress update by late February 2024 on the high school assessment recommendations, after voting to sever items involving future contract negotiations, police memorandums, district visioning, and security job classifications.

items.title: Condolences and Moment of Silence
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences and held a moment of silence in memory of several former district staff, educators, and community family members.
